note: Canonical, byte-deterministic (de)serialization of a clause MapProgram to a ground ontos Value (logos-contract §10, issue #310), reusing the FROZEN §2a quote tags + the §9 account clause encoding. program_to_value(p) = Tuple[ Atom(version), entry... ], where version = 'logos/program/v1' (hex below) and each entry = Tuple[ Atom(<clause-id utf8 bytes>), clause_value(clause) ]; clause_value is the account encoding quote(Tuple[head-as-term, Tuple[body-lit-as-term...]]) (head/positive-body goal reads as Tuple[Atom(pred), args...]; a NEGATED body literal reads as Tuple[Atom(0x00), goal-as-term], authored {neg:<goal>}). The entries are emitted in CANONICAL ORDER — sorted ascending by the clause-id bytes — so the value and its ontos-codec-v1 bytes are INDEPENDENT of MapProgram insertion order. Canonical bytes := ontos-codec-v1(program_to_value(p)). Each {rs,go,ts} binding rebuilds the program below via its builder API, serializes it, and MUST reproduce program_bytes_hex AND round-trip (program_from_value(program_to_value(p)) == p). Term notation as in account.json: term = {atom:<hex>}|{atom_str:<utf8>}|{tuple:[term...]}|{int:N}; goal = {pred:<utf8>, args:[term...]}; negated body literal = {neg:<goal>}. The 'clauses' below are authored in a deliberately NON-sorted insertion order (reach_rec, permit, nested, nullary, edge_ab) to exercise the canonical sort.

program.note: A representative program: facts, a multi-literal rule with vars, a negated body literal (ADR 0007), a nested compound + the ontos-data int embedding, and a nullary goal. clauses[] is the (id, head, body) set in INSERTION order; canonical_clause_order is the id order the serializer emits (sorted by id bytes).
